title: find_immutable_patch_key path-segment check prevents false positives
description: The byte-index check in find_immutable_patch_key (email.rs:641-644) distinguishes 'messageId' (blocked) from 'messageId/0' (blocked) from 'messageIdX' (allowed) using starts_with + byte-index guard on '/'. A naive starts_with would incorrectly block the third case. This is correct and should be defended if a future contributor suggests simplifying to starts_with alone.
